intro: A set of Claude Code plugins covered AI tool management, configuration, image and video production, security auditing, Conda environments, scheduling, filesystem organisation, general development, Git and GitHub, networking, learning, Linux desktops and servers, research, and writing. Documentation covered a desktop backup plan and an index of Israel-related repositories, alongside Israel-specific agent skills.
